versions.content: If an indicator is configured for controlling the MIL of an OBD- relevant ECU, the Dem module shall use the configured event failure cycle counter of this event (refer to 0 Fault confirmation) to define the maximum number of tested and failed cycles, before the stored event activates the respective indicator.
